CREATIVE ARTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Black, white, and grey
   B. Green, orange, and purple
   C. Brown, pink, and gold
   D. Red, blue, and yellow

2. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The ticket price
   B. Only the volume
   C. Only the costume
   D. The speed of the music

3. Best practice when working on Football: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Football.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Football.
   C. Damage equipment used for Football.
   D. Practise Football with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

4. Best practice when working on Wind Musical Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Wind Musical Instruments.
   B. Damage equipment used for Wind Musical Instruments.
   C. Practise Wind Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Wind Musical Instruments.

5. Best practice when working on Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts : (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .
   B. Disrupt classmates during Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .
   C. Practise Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts  with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .

6. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace drinking water
   B. Remove the need for rules
   C. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   D. Guarantee a trophy

7. Best practice when working on Rounders: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Rounders.
   B. Damage equipment used for Rounders.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Rounders.
   D. Practise Rounders with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. Best practice when working on Athletics: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Athletics.
   B. Damage equipment used for Athletics.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Athletics.
   D. Practise Athletics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

9. Best practice when working on Kenyan Folk Dance: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Folk Dance.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Folk Dance.
   C. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Folk Dance.
   D. Practise Kenyan Folk Dance with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

10. Best practice when working on Fabric Decoration: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Fabric Decoration.
   B. Damage equipment used for Fabric Decoration.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Fabric Decoration.
   D. Practise Fabric Decoration with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

11. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.

12. Best practice when working on Puppetry: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Puppetry.
   B. Practise Puppetry with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Puppetry.
   D. Damage equipment used for Puppetry.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Indigenous Kenyan Games and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Analysis of Creative Arts Works 15 Total Number of Lessons 180 NOTE: The suggest and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Analysis of Creative Arts works and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Wind Musical Instruments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
